description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException' used within the Orleans.Storage.Internal namespace to handle etag mismatch errors in memory storage when working with granular storage versions. It includes properties for stored and received etags, serialization support, and a method to convert to an InconsistentStateException.

classes.name: MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating an etag mismatch error in in-memory storage, with properties for stored and received etags, serialization support, and conversion to an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the exception with stored and received etags.

methods.name: MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException (Serialization constructor)
methods.description: Private constructor used for deserialization, initializes exception from serialization info.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Overrides serialization method to add custom etag info during serialization.

methods.name: AsInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Converts this exception into an InconsistentStateException with a detailed message.
